system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 41. 2 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (46 seconds, code score 0.79) ---
[b00] ACTION: Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.
[b01] CATHERINE (smug, taunting): "There she is."
[b02] NOBLEWOMAN (gleeful, whispering): "Look at her."
[b03] NOBLEMAN (mocking, chuckling): "She actually came back to the chapel."
[b04] NOBLEWOMAN (scornful, smug): "Not as a bride this time."
[b05] CATHERINE (derisive, projecting): "Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around."
[b06] CATHERINE (mocking, resonant): "This is the world you thought you belonged to."
[b07] CATHERINE (spiteful, boastful): "And now they can all see what you truly are."
[b08] ACTION: Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.
[b09] JULIANA (defiant, unbowed): "You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?"
[b10] CATHERINE (murmured, cold): "Still arrogant. Still standing."

--- WINDOW 1 (26 seconds, code score 0.73) ---
[b00] JULIANA (defiant, unbowed): "You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?"
[b01] CATHERINE (murmured, cold): "Still arrogant. Still standing."
[b02] CATHERINE (dismissive): "Come."
[b03] CATHERINE (intimate, ambitious): "Soon, there will be nothing left between us and the Ashburgh title."
[b04] BLOND NOBLEMAN (quietly triumphant): "Nothing."
[b05] PRIEST (solemn, polite): "Shall we?"
[b06] SFX: Ear-splitting detonation, shattering stone, wood splintering violently into kindling, followed by terrified screams of the congregation.
[b07] ACTION: A violent fireball bursts inward as the entire cathedral entrance explodes, blasting the massive double doors and masonry into flying shrapnel and billowing smoke.

Pick the single best promo.
